name: Zhipu
notes: Zhipu AI and Zhipu are the same company (rebranded to Z.ai internationally). IPO raised $558M on 2026-01-08. Total pre-IPO funding was ~$1.4B. Series D (Dec 2024) was $420M. DB value significantly underestimates actual total.

name: Weride
notes: WeRide is an autonomous driving company (also known as 文远知行). IPO on Nasdaq in Oct 2024 raised $439.9M. Prior to IPO, Series D+ (Nov 2022) at $5.1B valuation. Total funding $1.09B-$1.442B depending on source.

name: Denodo
notes: Denodo is a data virtualization platform. Raised $336M Series B from TPG and HGGC in Sep 2023. This appears to be the company's total known funding.

name: AI21 Labs
notes: AI21 Labs is an LLM company. Series D round in May 2025 raised $300M. Total funding now $636M ($336M before Series D). DB only captured pre-Series D amount.

name: Lambda Labs
notes: Lambda Labs is a GPU cloud provider for AI. Series C in Feb 2024 raised $320M (for $1.5B valuation). Series D in 2025 raised $480M (at $4B valuation). Total funding now ~$800M+.

name: Moveworks
notes: Moveworks raised $315M in equity funding over 3 rounds ($30M Series A 2019, $75M Series B 2019, $200M Series C 2021). Acquired by ServiceNow on 2025-12-15 for $2.85B (announced 2025-03-10). DB value matches equity funding total.

name: Skilled AI
notes: Could not verify 'Skilled AI' as a distinct company. Search results primarily show 'Skild AI' (robotics), 'Skills.ai', and 'Skillful AI Foundation' but none match the exact name/description. Likely a naming issue or misspelling. Skild AI (different company) has raised $1.83B-$2.21B total.

name: Deepexi
notes: Deepexi is a Chinese software company. CB Insights reports $270.57M in pre-IPO funding over 9 rounds. Largest round was Series B for $100M (Aug 2021). IPO on HK Stock Exchange in Oct 2025 raised ~HK$710M (~$91M). Total including IPO significantly higher.

name: CloudWalk Technology
notes: Two different companies named CloudWalk Technology exist: (1) Chinese facial recognition company - raised $379M Series B in 2017; (2) Brazilian payments company - raised $481M over 5 equity rounds. Cannot determine which one DB refers to. DB value of $300M matches neither company accurately.

name: Writer
notes: Writer is an enterprise AI/LLM company. Series C in Nov 2024 raised $200M at $1.9B valuation. Total funding is $369M over 12 rounds (per Crunchbase). DB underestimated by ~$69M.
